usage: jbus queue [-h]
                  {show,add,approve,hold,remove,withdraw,rename,apply,verify,check} ...

positional arguments:
  {show,add,approve,hold,remove,withdraw,rename,apply,verify,check}
    show                the rows still open, as Markdown
    add                 a row, with its brief on stdin
    approve             record the go for the brief the user was shown
    hold                take a row's approval back: no launch, and no merge
    remove              take a row out of the queue for good
    withdraw            take out a row that never launched, as the home that
                        runs it: for a row of your own that is not needed
    rename              move a row that never launched to a new slug, with its
                        columns and its go
    apply               a batch of the four verbs on stdin, all or none
    verify              the row's approval record and whether it holds for a
                        brief, as JSON
    check               the faults of the lines of the brief on stdin, one a
                        line; writes nothing

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
